noah: FYI ran a bring-up smoke for marlin-embed-v2 (1024d) on the contracts holdout w/ 4-fold stratified eval. int8 dynamic quant shows a big R@5 regression on fold 2 only. dumping notes here.

emma: concrete numbers?

noah: summary table (R@1,R@5,R@10,mean_norm):
```
foldA: 0.48, 0.77, 0.86, 1.05
foldB: 0.19, 0.41, 0.58, 0.12  <-- odd
foldC: 0.50, 0.78, 0.87, 1.03
foldD: 0.49, 0.76, 0.85, 1.01
```

rafi: foldB mean_norm=0.12? that suggests scale collapse. is this from exporter or runtime?

noah: traced chain: model exported to ONNX (opset 13), `quantize_dynamic` used with default per-tensor scales, then inference via onnxruntime with `ORTExecutionProvider` on CPU for this smoke. float32 baseline for foldB R@5=0.79. so quant path is the issue.

pieter: is index the same? we use Faiss IVF+PQ for these runs or HNSW?

noah: faiss IVF-PQ (nlist=1024, m=16) with dot product (we re-normalize to unit vectors but the PQ path still uses reconstructed vectors). recall measured by top-5 dot.

emma: could be PQ + quantization interacting badly if reconstructed vectors have different scale distribution. any inspect of embedding L2 dist / hist?

noah: yes — per-fold histograms attached (quick sample): float norms (foldB queries) mean=1.02 std=0.08; int8 norms (foldB) mean=0.11 std=0.07. other folds stable (int8 means ~0.98).

rafi: that points to quant scale misapplication for that shard / batch during export. did the dynamic quant step see representative data?

noah: not explicitly — we ran dynamic quant on the exported model without a calibration dataset.

pieter: dynamic quant uses per-tensor by default in ONNX. try per-channel for weights (it reduces scale error for conv/linear). also try static post-training quant with a small calibration set (1000 samples) to get better activation ranges.

noah: quick repro: re-export with `quantize_dynamic(model, per_channel=True, weight_type=QuantType.QUInt8)` and also produced a static quant run with calibration using `quantize_static` on 2k examples. eval-bot spun a job.

eval-bot: auto-run results (id eq-4145671111-rt1): per-channel dynamic int8 foldB R@5=0.76; static calibrated int8 foldB R@5=0.78; float32 foldB R@5=0.79. full CSV: s3://redwood-artifacts/eq-4145671111/metrics.csv

emma: nice — per-channel + calibration recovered most of the gap. add to onboarding checklist: prefer per-channel weight quant + static calibration for onnx export for embeddings.

rafi: additional safeguard: add an embedding-norm sanity metric into kfold harness. if any fold's int8 mean_norm < 0.6 * float_mean -> fail with artifact dump (top-20 worst).

noah: agree. also found that short-query cohorts (queries < 8 tokens) are disproportionately affected. foldB had 48% short queries. we should stratify by query length during kfold splitting.

pieter: and PQ index training should use representative quantized vectors (i.e., train PQ on int8-dequant outputs) so reconstruction distribution matches serving.

eval-bot: queued a follow-up: retrain IVF+PQ on static int8 reconstructions and re-eval. run id eq-4145671111-pq1.

deploy-bot: pausing canary rollout for marlin-embed-v2-int8 across the dedicated pool until post-quant validation gates pass. ticket: RD-2209. @noah please ack when resolved.

noah: acked. immediate action items Ill take: 1) add `--stratify-short-queries` flag to tools/eval_kfold.py; 2) implement norm-check threshold in harness and hook to CI; 3) re-export with per-channel & run static calibration; 4) retrain PQ on quantized reconstructions and re-run.

emma: Ill update the onboarding doc and add a short section about "quantization + index parity" and note the calibration recommendation.

pieter: for logging: include a small diagnostic dump in artifacts: sample queries where float_dot > 0.75 but int8_dot < 0.25, plus norms and reconstructed vectors. helps debugging if we see drift again.

rafi: long-term: consider adding a nightly job that runs short-query heavy holdouts through quantized builds to catch regressions earlier.

noah: thanks everyone. will post results in this thread when PQ retrain completes. :coffee:

eval-bot: summary diff: mean_R@5 float=0.775, per-tensor-int8=0.504, per-channel-int8=0.768, static-calib-int8=0.775. artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/eq-4145671111/summary_diff.json

noah: closing for now; will reopen if repro resurfaces.
